comment: Synthesized AIDCS Function Registry for Dashboard, AdminDashboard, and Login

actions.name: login_user
actions.description: Submits user credentials to authenticate against the system

actions.name: navigate_to_route
actions.description: Triggers the router to change pages (e.g., to /dashboard or /admin)

actions.name: toggle_theme
actions.description: Switch between light and dark mode

actions.name: export_metrics_report
actions.description: Download or save the current dashboard metrics as a file

actions.name: read_chart_data
actions.description: Extract data points from the main display chart

actions.name: view_user_details
actions.description: Open a modal or navigate to a specific user's details profile

actions.name: delete_user
actions.description: Remove a user from the system via the admin panel

actions.name: update_global_settings
actions.description: Save changes made in the admin settings panel

actions.name: read_system_logs
actions.description: Read the recent system exceptions or logs from the admin dashboard

actions.name: display_chat_message
actions.description: Show feedback or queries from the AI assistant

actions.name: initialize_api_credentials
actions.description: Checks the .env configuration for a default AI API key. If missing, it triggers a UI prompt to ask the user to provide an API key.

actions.name: stream_tts_google_voice_ws
actions.description: Connects to a WebSocket for continuous, zero-latency Google Text-to-Speech (TTS) voice streaming tailored for the AI Assistant without the latency of standard REST APIs.

actions.name: sync_page_content_cache
actions.description: Scrapes the current webpage content (and approved external site data) and stores it locally as a page-wise JSON cache for instant offline retrieval.

actions.name: grant_database_access
actions.description: Updates the system to allow the content manager to connect to the database or external APIs based on Admin toggle.

actions.name: navigate_via_content_summary
actions.description: Allows the Navigation Agent to read the page summary generated by the Content Agent and autonomously trigger a route change based on semantic context rather than explicit URLs.

actions.name: connect_netzach_finetuning
actions.description: Pushes the current agent's interaction logs to the Netzach API for automated fine-tuning and model improvement.

actions.name: purchase_agent_subscription
actions.description: Triggers checkout. Upon successful subscription, gives return access by redirecting the user to https://aidcs.netzachs.com/{user_id}.

actions.name: sync_netzach_integration
actions.description: Authenticates and binds the local AIDCS instance securely to the overarching Netzach ecosystem against https://aidcs.netzachs.com/.

actions.name: register_netzach_account
actions.description: Calls https://aidcs.netzachs.com/ to provision a new user account, securing privacy policy and terms of service acknowledgments before submission.

actions.name: save_aidcs_permissions
actions.description: Commits the global search bounds for the AI agents (e.g., Local Web Data Only vs. External Search).

actions.name: toggle_agent_functions
actions.description: Globally enables or safely disables specific AI capabilities from the matrix during the initial setup.

actions.name: fetch_api_usage_metrics
actions.description: Retrieves real-time token usage and cost estimation statistics specifically for the integration dashboard.

actions.name: report_system_error
actions.description: Allows any operating AI agent or the main frontend website to safely report execution errors or API failures directly to Netzach via https://aidcs.netzachs.com/error/{user_id}.
